title: mRNA transport, translation, and decay in adult mammalian central nervous system axons.
authors: Jung, Jane; Ohk, Jiyeon; Kim, Hyeyoung; Holt, Christine E; Park, Hyun Jung; Jung, Hosung
one_liner_zh: 该文研究成年哺乳动物中枢神经系统轴突中mRNA的运输、翻译和降解，属于神经生物学RNA调控，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: Localized mRNA translation regulates synapse function and axon maintenance, but how compartment-specific mRNA repertoires are regulated is largely unknown. We developed an axonal transcriptome capture method that allows deep sequencing of metabolically labeled mRNAs from retinal ganglion cell axon terminals in mouse. Comparing axonal-to-somal transcriptomes and axonal translatome-to-transcriptome enables genome-wide visualization of mRNA transport and translation and unveils potential regulators tuned to each process. FMRP and TDP-43 stand out as key regulators of transport, and experiments in Fmr1 knockout mice validate FMRP's role in the axonal transportation of synapse-related mRNAs. Pulse-and-chase experiments enable genome-wide assessment of mRNA stability in axons and reveal a strong coupling between mRNA translation and decay. Measuring the absolute mRNA abundance per axon terminal shows that the adult axonal transcriptome is stably maintained by persistent transport. Our datasets provide a rich resource for unique insights into RNA-based mechanisms in maintaining presynaptic structure and function in vivo.
abstract_zh: 局部mRNA翻译调控突触功能和轴突维持，但区室特异性mRNA库如何被调控在很大程度上尚不清楚。我们开发了一种轴突转录组捕获方法，能够对小鼠视网膜神经节细胞轴突末梢中代谢标记的mRNA进行深度测序。比较轴突与胞体转录组以及轴突翻译组与转录组，可实现mRNA运输和翻译的全基因组可视化，并揭示针对每个过程调控的潜在因子。FMRP和TDP-43作为运输的关键调控因子脱颖而出，且在Fmr1敲除小鼠中的实验验证了FMRP在突触相关mRNA轴突运输中的作用。脉冲追踪实验能够全基因组评估轴突中mRNA的稳定性，并揭示mRNA翻译与降解之间的强耦合。测量每个轴突末梢的绝对mRNA丰度表明，成年轴突转录组通过持续运输得以稳定维持。我们的数据集为深入理解基于RNA的机制在体内维持突触前结构和功能提供了丰富资源。
